questions.question: How often should I post on X to actually grow?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social recommends posting consistently throughout the day rather than dumping posts all at once, combined with timing posts around platform-measured optimal send times.

questions.question: Do reposts matter more than likes for growth on X?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social states reposts carry roughly 20x the algorithmic weight of a like, so encouraging reposts/bookmarks matters more than chasing likes.

questions.question: Does X Premium actually increase organic reach?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social reports Premium accounts see a 2x–4x reach boost versus non-Premium accounts, meaning free accounts face a real algorithmic disadvantage.

questions.question: How much video content should I be posting on X?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social cites that four out of five user sessions on X now include watching video, making video a priority format for growth.

questions.question: How fast should I respond to replies to boost my reach?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social recommends replying within 2–3 hours to keep engagement signals strong for the algorithm.

questions.question: Is organic reach declining for regular (non-Premium) accounts?
questions.answer_summary: Sprout Social's analysis frames non-Premium organic reach as 'significantly lower,' a structural constraint independent of content quality.

questions.question: What free templates exist for planning X content alongside other platforms?
questions.answer_summary: Buffer's resource library offers free social calendar templates (Buffer, Google Sheets, Canva, Notion, PDF) usable for planning X posts as part of a broader schedule.
